test_case.test_name: AMD in-band GFX/ODECC uncorrectable driver reporting
test_case.purpose: Prove one approved GFX/ODECC uncorrectable injection reaches the intended GPU and produces attributable AMDGPU driver evidence with safe recovery.
required_package: GPU UUID/OAM/BDF and omitted -d default-selection proof
Expected dmesg fields/timeout and GPU reset/rebind/reboot/OOB recovery
test_case.test_command: Qualified operator records GPU/process/driver/RAS/log baseline, safely loads or verifies amdgpu ras_enable=1, runs the source device0/block0 query with its limited meaning documented, proves which GPU the omitted selector targets, executes `amdgpuras -b 2 -s 0 -t 4` once, captures exact success plus timestamped GFX-attributed dmesg, then performs approved recovery/restoration and health checks.
test_case.expected_result: The intended GPU alone receives the GFX UCE; the tool reports success, dmesg contains the approved attributable hardware-error fields within timeout, no uncontrolled error storm occurs, and GPU/driver health is restored.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires immutable target/tool/driver identity, one injection, exact success output, GFX-specific dmesg attribution and completed recovery. Ambiguous default target, generic error only, wrong block, hang or failed recovery fails/blocks.
safety_gate: Critical injection authorization on dedicated idle GPU SUT.
Do not run until omitted -d behavior and active workloads are verified.
Preserve baseline logs instead of blanket clearing.
One injection only; no automatic retry, reset or reboot.
expected_evidence: GPU UUID/OAM/BDF, tool/driver/firmware and ras_enable state
Limited UMC query output and default-target proof
Timestamped GFX-specific dmesg context and error-storm check
Recovery, restored driver state and all-GPU health
test_case.recovery: On wrong GPU, error storm, reset or hang, preserve logs and use only the approved reset/rebind/reboot/OOB procedure; never retry automatically and restore ras_enable/module state.
